overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）、金融科技（1 篇）。方法上以横截面分析、数值模拟为主。来源分布：arXiv（8 篇）、OpenAlex（4 篇）。

papers.title: Mathematical Coding as an Application of Graph Theory: A Sustainable Approach to Urban Structure Analysis
papers.venue: Journal of Architectural/Planning Research and Studies (JARS)
papers.abstract: This study investigates the application of graph theory through mathematical coding in structuring anddeveloping pedestrian pathways within the complex morphology of traditional Arabic souqs (historic marketplaces).By employing Eulerian paths, space syntax analysis, and circulation assessments, we demonstrate how urbanwalkability can be enhanced through systematic network transformations. The research conceptualizes pathlabeling as a coding sequence, demonstrating how mathematical structures can reconstruct pedestrian networksto minimize discontinuity and maximize accessibility. Focusing on the historic Arabic souq in Baghdad, thisstudy examines an urban pedestrian network shaped by organic alleyways, which have been disrupted bymodern vehicular interventions. We assess how traditional pedestrian routes have been reconfigured, resultingin a reduction of their spatial integration. Through the graph theory-based transformation, we resolve odddegreenodes, ensuring that pedestrian paths form Eulerian circuits with continuous, uninterrupted movementsequences. Applying space syntax, we measure the changes in spatial configuration revealing a recalibratedurban fabric with improved mobility and socio-spatial cohesion. Findings showed that leveraging graph-theoreticprinciples in urban design fosters sustainable pedestrian environments, reinstating historic circulation patternsand enhancing integration values. The results demonstrate a tangible improvement in spatial intelligibility andaccessibility by ensuring seamless pedestrian flow. Unlike conventional vehicular centric planning, which oftendisrupts the historical spatial syntax, this approach offers an algorithmic strategy that balances heritageconservation with contemporary urban demands. By fostering urban walkability as a computational problem,this study underscores the transformative role of mathematical coding in urban planning. The research encouragesthe integration of graph theory into spatial design, proposing a novel methodology for reconciling modernmobility needs with the intrinsic logic of historic pedestrian networks.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了如何运用图论与数学编码技术，在传统阿拉伯集市（历史悠久的商业市场）复杂的空间结构中规划和构建行人通行路径。通过采用欧拉路径（Eulerian paths）、空间句法分析（space syntax analysis）及交通流评估（circulation assessments）等方法，我们展示了如何通过系统性的网络重构来提升城市的步行友好性。研究将路径标记（path labeling）视为一种编码序列，说明数学结构如何帮助重建行人网络，以减少通行中的不连续性并最大化通行便利性。以巴格达的传统阿拉伯集市为例，该研究分析了受现代车辆通行影响而发生改变的有机型小巷（organic alleyways）所构成的城市行人网络。研究发现，传统行人路径的布局已被重新调整，导致其空间整合度下降。通过基于图论的优化方法，我们消除了网络中的“奇异节点”（odd greenodes），确保行人路径能够形成连续、无障碍的欧拉回路（Eulerian circuits）。利用空间句法分析，我们测量了空间配置的变化，发现城市结构得到了优化，从而提升了通行效率和社会空间的凝聚力。研究结果表明，在城市设...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Analysis of Economic Factors and Corruption on Foreign Direct Investment in ASEAN Countries
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the effects of economic growth, inflation, trade openness, exchange rates, interest rates, and the Corruption Perception Index on foreign direct investment (FDI) in seven ASEAN countries during the period 2010–2024. The study uses panel data that combine time-series and cross-sectional observations. The analytical technique is panel data regression with the Fixed Effect Model approach. The results show that, jointly, economic growth, inflation, trade openness, exchange rates, interest rates, and the Corruption Perception Index have a significant effect on foreign direct investment, with a coefficient of determination of 88.03 percent. Individually, trade openness, interest rates, and the Corruption Perception Index have positive and significant effects on foreign direct investment. Economic growth and inflation have positive but insignificant effects, while the exchange rate has a positive effect that is significant at the 10 percent level.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本研究旨在分析2010年至2024年期间，经济增长、通货膨胀、贸易开放度、汇率、利率以及腐败感知指数对七个东盟国家外国直接投资（FDI）的影响。研究采用了结合时间序列和横截面观测数据的面板数据方法，并运用了固定效应模型的面板数据回归分析技术。研究结果表明，经济增长、通货膨胀、贸易开放度、汇率、利率和腐败感知指数共同对外国直接投资产生了显著影响，解释力度达到88.03%。其中，贸易开放度、利率和腐败感知指数对外国直接投资具有正向且显著的促进作用；经济增长和通货膨胀虽然也对外国直接投资有正向影响，但这种影响并不显著；而汇率的正面影响在10%的显著性水平上得以体现。。研究方法：面板数据、固定效应、横截面分析、回归分析。

papers.title: The Panel Information Matrix Test
papers.abstract: The Information Matrix (IM) test is a natural specification check for likelihood-based models, yet cross-sectional implementations are often badly sized, confound neglected heterogeneity with distributional misspecification, and require third derivatives. We develop the panel information matrix (PIM) test for models with fixed effects. Explicit fixed effects isolate functional-form misspecification from time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity. Although the profile maximum likelihood estimator inherits incidental-parameter bias of order $O(1/T)$, the leading bias of the profile PIM is of order $\sqrt{n}/T$, so it is asymptotically negligible whenever $n/T^2\to 0$, which includes the rectangular regime $n/T\to\mathrm{const}$, and stabilizes under parabolic asymptotics $n/T^2\toρ\in(0,\infty)$. This robustness arises because the indicator fluctuates at rate $\sqrt{n}$ rather than $\sqrt{nT}$. The same rate argument makes third-derivative corrections asymptotically unnecessary, so the test uses only first- and second-order likelihood derivatives. Simulations confirm that asymptotic PIM critical values suffice in moderately long panels, even when Wald tests for $θ$ are badly sized, while a parametric bootstrap largely removes size distortions when $ρ>0$.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】信息矩阵（IM）检验是一种适用于基于似然模型的自然规格检验方法，然而横截面数据的实现方式往往存在问题：样本量选择不当，容易将未被充分考虑的异质性与模型分布设定错误混为一谈，并且需要使用三阶导数。为此，我们针对具有固定效应的模型开发了面板信息矩阵（PIM）检验方法。这种检验方法能够将函数形式的设定错误与时间不变的未观测异质性区分开来。尽管基于轮廓最大似然估计量的偏差为$O(1/T)$阶，但PIM检验的主要偏差为$\sqrt{n}/T$阶；因此当$n/T^2\to 0$时（包括$n/T\to\mathrm{const}$的情况），该偏差在渐近意义上可以忽略不计；而在$n/T^2\toρ\in(0,\infty)$的抛物线型渐近条件下，该检验的稳定性也能得到保障。这种稳健性源于指标变量的变化速率仅为$\sqrt{n}$，而非$\sqrt{nT}$。同样的速率分析表明，在渐近意义上无需进行三阶导数的修正，因此该检验仅使用一阶和二阶似然导数即可。模拟结果表明，在样本量适中的情况下，PIM检验的临界值足以满足统计要求；即使当用于估计参数$\theta$的Wald检验的样本量选择不当时，参数自...。研究方法：固定效应、横截面分析、最大似然估计、数值模拟。

papers.title: Protecting Losers Undermines Auction Credibility
papers.abstract: A second-price auction must determine its price but need not learn how far losing values lie below it. We show that protecting this information from the seller conflicts with auction credibility. In deterministic protocols with private communication, lower-tail privacy forces the first informative question to reveal whether a bidder has the highest possible value. The seller can then manipulate the winner's payment without any bidder detecting the deviation, increasing revenue at some valuation profiles and never reducing it. A descending protocol conceals losing values below the price but permits manipulation; with mandatory sale, a credible ascending protocol reveals them.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在第二价格拍卖中，拍卖方必须确定最终价格，但无需了解低于该价格的损失值的具体范围。我们指出，若将这一信息保密，将损害拍卖的公信力。在采用私有通信的确定性拍卖协议中，为保护低概率事件（即“尾部隐私”）而设计的规则会迫使竞拍者首先透露自己的最高出价。这样一来，卖方便可以在不引起任何竞拍者察觉的情况下操纵获胜者的支付金额，从而在某些价格区间内增加收入，甚至在某些情况下还能提升收入。而采用递减出价规则的拍卖协议虽然能够隐藏低于价格的损失值，但允许卖方进行操纵；而在强制成交的拍卖协议中，采用递增出价规则的拍卖方式则能够揭示这些损失值。。

papers.title: Infinite Mindset and Self-Assessed Rice Farmer Capacity: Digital, Dynamic, and Managerial Pathways in West Aceh, Indonesia
papers.venue: Best Journal of Administration and Management
papers.abstract: Long-term orientations may support agricultural continuity, but their relationship with rice farmer capacity depends on more operational capabilities. This study examines digital capability, dynamic capability, and managerial competence as parallel statistical pathways linking infinite mindset to self-assessed rice farmer capacity in West Aceh, Indonesia. Descriptive analysis and independent partial least squares path modelling used the same 90 rice farmers, retaining 32 indicators and the direct mindset–capacity path. One missing capacity response was replaced by its observed indicator mean; an 89-case complete-response model provided a sensitivity check. Inference used 5,000 respondent-level bootstrap resamples, supplemented by location-cluster resampling and alternative specifications. Infinite mindset was positively associated with digital capability (β = 0.363), dynamic capability (β = 0.551), and managerial competence (β = 0.447). In the primary model, only managerial competence had a capacity association excluding zero (β = 0.560; 95% interval: 0.300–0.781). Its indirect association was 0.250 (0.122–0.418) and remained positive across the principal checks. Digital-path inference changed under location resampling, while the primary direct, digital-indirect, and dynamic-indirect intervals included zero. Capacity R² was 0.447, but restrictive-model residual diagnostics limited confirmatory interpretation. The findings support testing practical management routines alongside digital and adaptive support in rice extension, not established causal mediation or digital irrelevance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】长期发展导向可能有助于农业的持续发展，但其与稻农能力之间的关系还取决于稻农的实际操作能力。本研究探讨了数字能力、动态能力和管理能力这三者作为潜在机制，分析它们如何在印度尼西亚西阿塞地区将“无限思维模式”（infinite mindset）与稻农自我评估的能力联系起来。研究采用了描述性分析和独立偏最小二乘路径建模方法，研究对象为90名稻农，保留了32个指标，并重点分析了“思维模式”与“能力”之间的直接关联。对于缺失的能力数据，采用其对应的观测指标平均值进行替代；最终构建了一个包含89个完整响应数据的模型以进行敏感性检验。推断过程基于5000次受访者级别的自助法重采样结果，并结合了地理位置聚类重采样及多种模型设定。研究结果表明，“无限思维模式”与数字能力（β = 0.363）、动态能力（β = 0.551）和管理能力（β = 0.447）呈正相关。在主要模型中，唯有管理能力与稻农能力之间存在显著的正相关关系（β = 0.560；95%置信区间：0.300–0.781）；其间接关联效应为0.250（0.122–0.418），且在各种检验中均保持正向。当考虑地理位置因素后，数字能力对稻农...。

papers.title: Rethinking municipal electricity in South Africa: Rooftop solar PV, revenue and just energy transitions in the City of Johannesburg
papers.venue: Journal of Energy in Southern Africa
papers.abstract: South Africa’s deepening electricity crisis, marked by persistent load-shedding and escalating tariffs, has accelerated private solar photovoltaic (PV) installations. This rapid transition has raised concerns about municipal revenue erosion, cross-subsidisation and energy inequality. The City of Johannesburg Metropolitan Municipality (CoJ) is at the centre of this transition, and is grappling with the implications for its business model and how private solar PV can be leveraged to support a just energy transition. This paper is written from the perspective of City officials, and examines the extent of rooftop solar PV and its impact on municipal revenue, finances and grid management. The paper draws on municipal records, internal meetings and reports, and an industry dataset. The analysis reveals that official records substantially underrepresent solar PV installations in the CoJ. Despite the concern that private solar PV erodes revenue, this analysis highlights that technical losses, load-shedding, and customer non-payment have a far greater financial impact. This paper challenges the assumption that distributed power undermines social justice, and rather points to the need for tariff reform, away from volumetric sales towards fixed network charges, to stabilise municipal finances. Rather than framing distributed solar PV as inherently threatening to municipal revenue and social justice, the paper shows that these outcomes depend on how municipal business models, tariffs and governance adapt to and leverage off decentralised energy.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】南非日益严重的电力危机——表现为频繁的限电措施和不断上涨的电价——加速了私人太阳能光伏（PV）系统的安装速度。这一快速转型引发了人们对市政收入减少、交叉补贴现象以及能源不平等问题的担忧。约翰内斯堡大都会市政府（CoJ）处于这一转型的核心位置，正在努力应对这一变化对其商业模式的影响，以及如何利用私人太阳能光伏来推动公平的能源转型。本文从市政府官员的角度出发，探讨了屋顶太阳能光伏系统的普及程度及其对市政收入、财政状况和电网管理的影响。研究数据来源于市政记录、内部会议报告以及行业统计数据。分析结果显示，官方统计数据显示的CoJ地区的太阳能光伏安装规模远低于实际情况。尽管有人担心私人太阳能光伏会侵蚀市政收入，但研究指出，技术损耗、限电措施以及用户欠费等因素对市政财政的负面影响更为显著。本文质疑了“分布式能源会破坏社会公平”这一观点，认为应通过改革电价结构（从按电量计费转向按网络使用费用计费）来稳定市政财政。研究表明，分布式太阳能光伏系统对市政收入和社会公平的潜在影响并非绝对负面，这些结果实际上取决于市政商业模式、电价政策以及治理机制如何适应并利用分布式能源技术。。

papers.title: Microfinance Competition in the Presence of Moneylenders: Theory and Evidence
papers.abstract: After decades of microfinance expansion and despite charging higher interest rates, moneylenders continue to exist alongside microfinance institutions (MFIs). We develop a dynamic model with ex post moral hazard, in which borrowers use MFI loans for production and can rely on moneylenders for bridge loans after shocks to repay MFIs and preserve future access to MFI credit. We then study how MFI competition shapes the coexistence between MFIs and moneylenders. The effect of competition on MFI credit is ambiguous: it may weaken repayment incentives or replace moneylenders as bridge lenders. By contrast, competition unambiguously reduces moneylender credit. In a village-level randomized expansion in Bangladesh, stratified by baseline MFI presence, one additional MFI reduces the number of moneylender loans by roughly 30-40% two to three years later, with no detectable effect on MFI or overall borrowing. This suggests that, in markets where MFIs rely primarily on the threat of exclusion to induce repayment and moneylenders provide emergency finance, gains from additional MFI entry may be greater in less saturated areas.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】经过数十年的小额信贷发展，尽管放贷者收取的利率较高，但他们仍然与小额信贷机构（MFIs）共存。我们构建了一个包含事后道德风险因素的动态模型，在该模型中，借款人利用小额信贷机构的贷款进行生产，并在遭遇冲击后向放贷者寻求过渡性贷款，以便偿还小额信贷机构的债务并保持未来获得信贷的资格。随后，我们研究了小额信贷机构之间的竞争如何影响这两种机构的共存关系。竞争对小额信贷机构信贷的影响具有不确定性：它可能会削弱借款人的还款意愿，或者使放贷者不再扮演过渡性贷款者的角色；相比之下，竞争无疑会减少放贷者的信贷业务。在孟加拉国进行的一项村级随机实验中，根据基线时小额信贷机构的分布情况对样本进行分层分析后发现，每增加一家小额信贷机构，两年到三年后放贷者的贷款数量会减少约30%至40%，同时对小额信贷机构本身的运营或整体借贷活动没有明显影响。这表明，在那些小额信贷机构主要依靠排斥机制来促使借款人还款、而放贷者提供紧急资金的市场中，新增小额信贷机构所带来的收益可能在竞争不那么激烈的地区更为显著。。研究方法：随机实验。

papers.title: The Myth of Restrictive Working-Time Agreements: Firms' Working-Time Adjustment after Exit from Collective Bargaining
papers.abstract: Employers in Germany argue that collective agreements restrict their flexibility concerning working hours. Using data from the IAB Establishment Panel for the years 2008 to 2024, we investigate working-time adjustments after exit from collective bargaining. We find that exit is associated with only a modest increase in weekly working hours of around 0.3 to 0.6 per cent using fixed-effects and event-study models, corresponding to eight to thirteen additional minutes per week. This adjustment occurs shortly after leaving collective bargaining coverage. We further find no evidence that other margins of working-time adjustment, such as Saturday or Sunday work, are used more extensively after exit. In contrast to previous survey evidence, our findings call into question that working-hours constraints are one of the main drivers of exit from collective bargaining coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：德国雇主常认为集体协议限制了工作时间灵活性，本文旨在研究企业退出集体谈判后的工作时间调整情况。

🔬 研究方法：研究利用2008年至2024年的IAB Establishment Panel数据，并采用固定效应和事件研究模型进行分析。

📊 核心发现：退出集体谈判后，企业每周工作时间仅增加0.3%至0.6%（约8至13分钟），且未发现企业更广泛地使用周六或周日工作等其他调整方式。

💡 应用价值：研究发现挑战了之前的调查证据，表明工作时间限制并非雇主退出集体谈判的主要驱动因素。

papers.title: Rolling Window Selection in FAR Models with Structural Instabilities
papers.abstract: The paper develops a theory for selecting the rolling window when generating out-of-sample forecasts with factor-augmented regression (FAR) models in the presence of structural instabilities. It shows how to select a rolling window by minimizing the conditional mean squared forecast error (MSFE) while accounting for uncertainty in factor estimation. Because the conditional MSFE is unobserved and the factors are latent, this paper proposes a feasible version of the criterion and derives conditions under which the new method is asymptotically loss-efficient. A simulation experiment documents the procedure's performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了一种理论，用于在存在结构不稳定性的情况下，利用因子增强回归（FAR）模型生成样本外预测时选择滚动窗口的方法。该理论阐述了如何通过最小化条件均方预测误差（MSFE）来选择滚动窗口，同时考虑因子估计的不确定性。由于条件MSFE是无法观测到的，且相关因子是隐性的，本文提出了一种可行的评估标准，并推导出新方法在渐近意义上具有损失效率的条件。通过模拟实验验证了该方法的性能。。研究方法：回归分析、数值模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: Multi-period Mean-Expectile Portfolio Optimization under Wasserstein Ambiguity: Reformulation, Degeneracy and the Role of the Ground Metric
papers.abstract: Expectiles are the only law-invariant risk measures that are both coherent and elicitable. Unlike Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), however, they do not admit a Rockafellar--Uryasev representation that admits tractable Wasserstein reformulations. We address this difficulty by developing an envelope theorem for worst-case expectiles that characterizes the worst-case expectile over a Wasserstein ambiguity set as the unique root of a worst-case expectation with a two-piece affine integrand. This representation permits direct application of standard Wasserstein duality.   Using this result, we reformulate a multi-period tri-level mean--expectile portfolio problem as four parametric linear programs with constraints. We establish four structural properties of the proposed model: an endogenously damped price of robustness, a decision-dependent critical radius beyond which the expectile tail component becomes inactive, exact recovery of the nominal model at zero ambiguity, and a characterization of how the Wasserstein ground metric determines whether the limiting portfolio becomes more concentrated or more diversified. Numerical experiments on 90 FTSE constituents over 3,341 out-of-sample trading days show that the expectile model outperforms a CVaR model matched on ambiguity set, radius, ground metric, and trade-off weight in all nine parameter cells---significantly so whenever the radius is non-trivial. The experiments further confirm the predicted degeneracy under the ground metric.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】期望值（Expectiles）是唯一既满足法律不变性（law-invariance），又具备一致性和可估计性（coherence and elicibility）的风险度量方法。然而，与条件风险价值（Conditional Value-at-Risk, CVaR）不同，期望值无法通过Rockafellar-Uryasev表示法进行简化处理，从而无法方便地应用Wasserstein距离理论进行进一步分析。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种针对最坏情况期望值的“包络定理”（envelope theorem），该定理将Wasserstein模糊集（ambiguity set）上的最坏情况期望值描述为具有两部分仿射被积函数（two-piece affine integrand）的最坏情况期望值的唯一解。这种表示方法使得标准Wasserstein对偶性（standard Wasserstein duality）可以直接应用于期望值的分析中。

基于这一结果，我们将多期三层次均值-期望值投资组合问题（multi-period tri-level mean-expectile portfolio...。研究方法：向量自回归、实验方法。

papers.title: Inference in Panel SVARs with Two-Way Dependence
papers.abstract: We develop inference for heterogeneous panel vector autoregressive (VAR) models and their structural impulse response functions, where the error terms are dependent in the cross-sectional and time dimensions (two-way dependence). For proxy-identified structural VARs, we first adapt mean-group estimation and construct a closed-form pooled identification. Considering the reduced-form VAR dynamics, residual covariances, and structural parameters, we derive a joint central limit theorem under joint limits in the cross-sectional and time dimensions. We then propose a recursive-design panel moving-block bootstrap that resamples the estimated error terms in (i) the temporal, (ii) the cross-sectional, or (iii) both dimensions jointly, and prove consistency of the joint panel-block scheme under two-way dependence. Simulations show coverage close to the nominal level for the joint scheme but severe undercoverage for cross-sectional resampling.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了针对异质性面板向量自回归（VAR）模型及其结构脉冲响应函数的推断方法，其中误差项在横截面和时间维度上存在双向依赖性。对于通过代理变量识别的结构VAR模型，我们首先采用了均值组估计方法，并构建了一种封闭形式的联合识别方法。在考虑简化形式的VAR动态、残差协方差以及结构参数的基础上，我们推导出了一个在横截面和时间维度上同时满足联合极限条件的中心极限定理。随后，我们提出了一种递归设计的面板移动块自助法（panel moving-block bootstrap），该方法可以对估计误差项在时间维度、横截面维度或两者同时进行重新抽样，并证明了该联合面板块估计方法在存在双向依赖性时的一致性。仿真结果表明，联合估计方法的覆盖率接近理论水平，而仅对横截面数据进行重新抽样的方法则存在严重的覆盖率不足问题。。研究方法：横截面分析、数值模拟。

papers.title: Dictatorial profiles: a proof of Arrow's theorem
papers.abstract: We study social welfare rules with strict individual and social preferences. A preference profile is dictatorial for a rule if the social preference coincides with some agent's preference and no agent with a different preference can change the social preference unilaterally. We establish that (i) a rule is dictatorial if and only if all of its profiles are dictatorial; and (ii) if a rule satisfies unanimity and independence (of irrelevant alternatives), then all its profiles must be dictatorial. These results constitute a proof of Arrow's Impossibility Theorem.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Dictatorial profiles: a proof of Arrow's theorem。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Economics、Finance」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。
